excerpt.zh: 我们的异星天然气赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our exotic gases deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的异星天然气赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our exotic gases deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

sections.zh: 异星天然气月度结余为正

texts.zh: 异星天然气在我们的国库中已经成了稀罕货——而它们的长期缺失对我们所有依赖它的生产流程都产生了严重的影响。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]强烈建议我们重新考虑预算优先级，以结束这一怪异的局势。
texts.en: Exotic Gases have become a foreign presence in our empire stockpile - and their continued absence is having an impact on our entire manufacturing process, which heavily depends on them. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] strongly suggests we reconsider our budget priorities to put an end to this outlandish situation.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取异星天然气。
label.en: Siphon exotic gases from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超难得”天然气。
label.en: We can live with our gases being more fleeting.

texts.zh: 我们的帝国已经再也无法应付异星天然气短缺对我们生产流程的毁灭性打击。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]被迫宣布破产，使我们得以违约债务。新的紧缩经济计划正在起草以削减开支，这样一来我们就可以逐渐重建我们的资源储备。
texts.en: Our empire can no longer cope with the exotic gas shortages that have been disrupting our manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has been forced to declare bankruptcy, allowing us to forfeit our debts. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, so that we may slowly rebuild our resource stockpile.
